content.summary: McCormick (NYSE:MKC) has added Gavin Hattersley and Rick Dierker to its Board of Directors. Hattersley is the former CEO of Molson Coors and Dierker is the current CEO of Church & Dwight. The appointments represent a refresh of McCormick's leadership structure and governance. McCormick is a global flavor and spice company with a footprint across retail, foodservice, and industrial channels. content.title: 3 Consumer Stocks We Keep Off Our Radar
content.summary: Consumer staples stocks are solid insurance policies in frothy markets ripe for corrections. On the other hand, they usually underperform during bull runs, and this paradigm has rung true over the past six months as the sector’s -4.9% decline paled in comparison to the S&P 500’s 8.2% gain.

content.title: Are consumer staples stocks still worth investing in?
content.description:
Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma and Slatestone Wealth chief market strategist Kenny Polcari come on Opening Bid to assess the state of the US consumer and whether the consumer staples (XLP) category still offers investors stability.

Also be sure to catch Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi's full interview with Procter & Gamble (PG) CFO Andre Schulten after the company released fourth quarter earnings results.
